facts.fact: Per a Gartner prediction cited by StackAdapt, by 2025 organizations using AI in their martech stacks will be able to shift 75% of their staff from production to strategic roles.
facts.quote: by 2025, organizations using AI in their martech stacks will be able to shift 75% of their staff from production to strategic roles.

facts.fact: The Marketer-to-Machine (M2M) Scale, introduced by the Marketing AI Institute, ranges from Level 0 (all manual) to Level 4 (fully autonomous) for rating intelligent automation in marketing AI technology.
facts.quote: This scale ranges from Level 0 (all manual) to Level 4 (fully autonomous)

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that its AI-powered programmatic ads let users test hundreds of ad variants against their campaigns before optimizing for effectiveness.
facts.quote: you can test hundreds of ad variants against your campaigns, then optimize for effectiveness.

facts.fact: The article was published on October 10, 2024.
